newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA - Durres - Eight vessels in port discharging of which 2 cement, 1 bulk wheat, 1 wheat flour, 1 coal, 1 nitrates, 1 container vessel, 1 mineral water. No vessels awaiting berth.

AZORES, July 1 - Ponta Delgada - All port loading/unloading operations were stopped due to local stevedores strike declared for undetermined time, until the conclusion of the negotiations being made with local government. There are 8 vessels in port unable to load/unload their cargoes.

BULGARIA, June 30 - Bourgas - 18 Vessels operating of which 15 loading, 1 cargo not nominated, 2 containers, 3 steel, 1 sugar, 4 fertiliser, 1 general, 1 clinker, 1 baryte concentrate, 1 fuel oil. 3 Discharging, 1 fishmeal, 1 zinc concentrate, 1 petrol. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 7 for loading, 1 cars, 3 oil/oil products, 1 metal, 1 tobacco, 1 cargo not nominated, 1 to discharge fish. 21 Vessels due of which 15 to load, 2 baryte concentrate, 6 steel, 1 lead, 1 other, 1 general, 1 zinc/pipes, 1 zinc, 1 benzene, 1 coke. 4 To discharge, 2 coal, 1 zinc concentrate/fishmeal, 1 zinc conctrate. 2 To discharge/load, salt/general, lead concentrate/lead.

Varna - 36 Vessels operating of which 22 loading, 6 soda, 1 sas, 1 frozen chicken, 3 cement, 3 clinker, 1 container vessel, 1 kaoline, 2 quartz sand, 1 constructions, 1 general, 1 glass, 1 trucks/containers. 6 Discharging, 1 phosphorite, 2 coal, 2 wheat, 1 container vessel. 1 Discharging/loading magnesite/scrap, 7 discharging/loading containers. 5 Vessels in roads of which 4 to load, 3 containers, 1 glass, 1 cargo not nominated.

CROATIA, June 30 - Rijeka - One vessel discharging at berth, 4 loading at berth, 1 berthed inoperative, 1 anchored, 3 due. Zadar - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 due. Split - One vessel loading at berth, 1 under repair/drydock. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth. Pula, Rasa, Sibenik, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, July 1 - Limassol - Vessels due on 2/7, 4 containers, 3 conventional, 5 passenger vessels, no delays expected. 7 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth. Larnaca - Vessels due on 2/7, 2 containers, 1 conventional, no delays expected. 1 Container vessel discharging/loading at berth.

ESTONIA, July 1 - Tallinn - City port - 2 Vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Pig iron loading at berth, 1 container discharging at berth, 1 liner vessel. Kopli - 7 Vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Vessel loading sawn timber at berth, 2 vessels discharging at berth of which 1 meat, 1 wheat. Parnu - 4 Vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Vessels loading timber at berth. Muuga - Vessels loading at berth, 3 fuel oil, 2 timber, 1 grain, 2 general cargo. Discharging at berth, 1 sugar, 1 petroleum, 2 general cargo, 1 frozen chicken.

ITALY, July 1 - Naples - One gas tanker berthed. Gaeta - One bulk carrier to berth 3/7. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 35 Vessels berthed, 2 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads, 2 vessels berthed. Savona - One vessel in roads, no delays. 2 Vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - One vessel in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 9 vessels berthed. Leghorn - Six vessels in roads, 28 berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads. Gaeta, Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Naples - One vessel in roads, no delays. Salerno - One vessel in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - No vessels in roads, 3 berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - One vessel in roads, 1 berthed. Palermo - No vessels in roads, no delays. Sarroch - Five vessels in roads, 7 berthed. Taranto - Three vessels in roads, no delays. Ravenna - 13 Vessels in roads. Venice - One vessel in roads, no delays. Trieste - Commercial port -

LATVIA, July 1 - Riga - 18 Vessels operating of which 5 timber loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 container loaders, 2 tankers, 1 fertiliser, 3 frozen foods dischargers, 2 awaiting operations, 2 sugar dischargers. No delays, 20 vessels due. Ventspils - Eight vessels operating of which 7 steel loaders, 1 mop loader. 1 Vessel awaiting operations outside. No delays, 11 vessels due.

LITHUANIA, June 30 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 fertiliser, 1 oil, 1 metal, 2 scrap, 2 timber, 1 steel coils. Discharging, 1 sugar, 1 vessel loading/discharging. 5 Vessels in roads, 22 due.

POLAND, July 1 - Szczecin - 72 Vessels due, 41 loading at berth, 27 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 14 under repair/drydock. Gdynia - Nine vessels operating of which 3 loading at berth (general cargo). 6 Discharging at berth (3 general cargo, 2 grain, 1 steel). 5 Vessels under repair/drydock, 28 due. Gdansk - Seven vessels operating of which 5 loading at berth (3 bulk, 1 general cargo, 1 coal). 2 Vessels discharging grain at berth, 1 coal vessel waiting in roads. 5 Vessels under repair, 21 due.

PORTUGAL, June 30 - Sines - Vessels operating in port, 3 discharging of which 1 crude, 1 coal, 1 chemical naphtha. 3 Loading of which 1 fuel oil, 1 unleaded gasoline, 1 gasoline/gasoil/jet fuel. Vessels waiting, 1 to discharge coal (awaiting berth), 1 to load butadiene (awaiting orders). Vessels due, 2 to discharge coal, 1 each to discharge crude, butane, 2 to load propylene, 1 each to load propane, metallic structures. Leixoes - Vessels operating, 11 general cargo, 2 container vessels. No vessels awaiting berth. Places vacant, 1 pier with cranes, 1 pier without cranes.

Lisbon - 35 Vessels due, 73 in port. 2 Loading at berth, 14 discharging at berth, 7 loading and discharging at berth, 3 loading at anchorage. 3 Bunkering, 17 under repair/drydock, 4 awaiting orders, 22 miscellaneous craft. July 1 - Setubal - Five vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 8 for discharging, 6 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock.

ROMANIA, June 30 - Constantza - 35 Vessels operating of which 20 generals loading, 8 bulkers loading/discharging, 5 bagged chemicals loading, 2 tankers loading/discharging. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 6 generals, 1 bagged chemicals loading, 1 tanker loading. Constantza Sud (Agigea) - 10 Vessels loading general cargo. Mangalia - One vessel loading general, 1 bulker loading. Midia - Three livestock carriers loading, 1 tanker loading.

RUSSIA, June 30 - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - 30 Vessels operating of which 15 loading, 6 non-ferrous, 5 fertiliser, 2 coal, 2 containers. 15 Discharging of which 1 frozen chicken, 2 containers, 3 sugar, 1 tubes, 1 trucks, 3 fertiliser, 2 vegetables/fruit, 2 oil. 8 Vessels awaiting operations, 7 due. Kaliningrad - 12 Vessels operating, no delays, 5 vessels due. Vyborg - Two vessels operating, no delays, 2 vessels due. Kaliningrad - Commercial port - 9 Vessels operating of which 6 loading (1 sawn timber, 1 gravel, 1 coal, 1 steel scrap, 1 pipes). 3 Discharging of which 2 pellets, 1 trailers. 1 Vessel preparing to load paper on reels, 10 vessels due, no delays. Fishery port - 5 Vessels operating of which 4 discharging (2 frozen fish, 2 animal food), 1 loading fertiliser. 2 Vessels due, no delays.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - 20 Vessels operating of which 11 loading, 5 steel, 1 paper/steel, 1 saltpetre, 1 scrap, 1 coal, 1 bulk cement, 1 cast iron. 9 Discharging, 4 various, 1 onion, 3 bulk sugar, 1 rice. 18 Vessels waiting in roads of which 8 to load, 2 scrap, 11 steel, 1 tin, 1 copper, 3 coal, 1 bulk cement, 1 cast iron, 1 equipment. 11 To discharge, 3 bulk sugar, 3 luggage, 1 equipment, 1 bulk maize, 1 rice, 1 bananas, 1 barytes. 4 To discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - July 1 - 2 Vessels berthed to load diesel oil, crude oil. 4 Crude oil tankers waiting in roads. 4 Tankers due of which 3 to load crude oil, 1 to load diesel oil.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - July 1 - Seven vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 coal, 1 iron pellets, 1 apatite, 1 non-ferrous metal, 1 general cargo, 1 npk loader awaiting berth. 4 Vessels due during the week of which 3 loaders (1 non-ferrous metal, 2 apatite), 1 alumina discharger.

SLOVENIA, June 30 - Koper - 12 Vessels berthed of which 2 containers loading/discharging, 2 car carriers loading/discharging cars, 2 general cargo loading paper and marble, 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 2 bulk carriers discharging quartzite, slags, 2 livestock vessels loading bulls, 1 chemical tanker discharging phosphoric acid. 9 Vessels due during next 2 days of which 5 containers to load/discharge, 1 car carrier to load cars, 1 general cargo to load rails, 1 chemical tanker to load chemicals. No delays expected.

SPAIN, June 28 - Santander - Vessels loading, 1 sodium phosphate, 1 wire steel reels. Unloading, 1 cars, 3 scrap, 1 fertiliser, 1 soyabeans, 1 phosphate, 1 corn gluten. June 30 - Bilbao - 26 Vessels operating of which 4 tankers, 22 dry cargo. 14 Discharging, 8 loading, 4 loading/discharging, no delays. July 1 - Pasajes - 17 Vessels in port of which discharging, 4 scrap, 1 each fertiliser, grain, coils, petcoke, grite, china clay. 1 Discharging/loading cars, 4 discharging/loading steel, 2 under repair, no delays. Cadiz - 21 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ro, 1 cement, 1 wheat, 1 semolina, 2 shipbuilding material, 13 repair, no delays. Aviles - 10 Vessels in port of which 6 loading (3 steel, 1 talc, 1 sulphuric acid, 1 clinker). 4 Discharging (1 alumina, 1 scrap, 1 phosphate, 1 tar).

Gijon - Nine vessels in port of which 7 loading (5 steel, 1 cement, 1 sugar). 2 Discharging (1 dunite, 1 asphalt), no delays or congestion. Sagunto - 16 Vessels operating of which 3 loading bulk fertiliser, 1 loading rice. 2 Discharging fresh fruit pallets, 2 discharging/loading steel products, 3 ro-ro discharging/loading general cargo, 1 ro-ro loading general cargo, 1 loading cement, 1 discharging timber, 2 discharging steel products. No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays.

UKRAINE, June 30 - Mariupol - 10 Vessels loading of which 3 steel, 3 fertiliser, 2 sulphur, 1 coal, 1 containers/steel/pipes. 11 Vessels waiting in roads of which 7 to load, 6 steel, 1 ammonia sulphate. 2 To discharge equipment, sleepers. 1 To discharge/load containers, 1 to load/discharge timber, equipment, pipes/containers. 21 Vessels due of which 13 to load, 4 map, 2 coal, 4 fire clay, 1 alumina, 2 steel. 7 To discharge 3 containers, 1 plasticate, 2 equipment, 1 coal. 1 To discharge/load alumina/sulphur. Odessa - 15 Vessels operating of which 9 loading, 6 metals, 1 urea, 1 crude oil, 1 fuel oil. 2 Discharging sugar, diesel oil, 2 passenger vessels, 2 under repair. 7 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load, 1 metal, 2 fuel oil, 1 cargo not nominated, 1 to discharge general cargo, 2 waiting. 9 Vessels due of which 6 to load 5 metal, 1 fertiliser, 2 to discharge containers, 1 to discharge/load containers.

Ilyichevsk - 13 Vessels operating of which 12 loading, 6 steel, 3 pig iron, 2 debars, 1 asbestos/equipment. 1 Discharging/loading containers. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load, 3 steel, 1 debars, 1 potash. 1 To discharge bulk soy. 7 Vessels due of which 5 to load, 2 steel, 1 debars, 1 cars, 1 potash, 1 to discharge oil, 1 to discharge/load containers. July 1 - Mariupol - Eight vessels loading at berth (metal products, fertiliser, sulphur, urea, coal). 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (metal products). 6 Waiting at anchorage to discharge (general cargo, containers, fertiliser, metal products). 1 Vessel reloading urea to sea going vessels, 1 vessel under repair/drydock, 9 floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur, metal products). 26 Vessels due for loading and discharging of fertiliser, metal products, coal, clay, pvc, alumina/sulphur, general cargo, containers.

Kerch - One vessel loading metal products at berth, 1 discharging metal products at berth, 2 under repair/drydock. Vessels due for loading, glass, metal products, ore. Berdiansk - Two vessels loading at berth of which 1 coal, 1 coke. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load clay. Odessa - Steel cargo loading, 4 vessels alongside, 3 due. Containers, 1 vessel alongside, 2 due. Tanker loading, 2 vessels alongside, 1 anchored, 2 due. Tanker discharging, 1 vessel alongside, general cargo, 1 alongside, 1 due. Fertiliser, 2 alongside, 1 anchored, bulk sugar, 1 alongside, 1 due. Ilyichevsk - Steel cargo loading, 6 vessels alongside.

YUGOSLAVIA, July 1 - Bar - Seven vessels berthed of which 1 discharging bananas, 1 discharging gas oil, 3 loading steel coils, 1 loading metal, 1 loading timber. Zelenika/Bijela - One vessel laid up, 6 under repair.
